27424-cautionary-tales-for-children.title: Cautionary Tales For Children
27424-cautionary-tales-for-children.creator: Unknown
27424-cautionary-tales-for-children.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. When Nurse informed his Parents, they  Were more Concerned than I can say:--  His Mother, as She dried her eyes,  Said, "Well--it gives me no surprise,  He would not do as he was told!"  His Father, who was self-controlled,  Bade all the children round attend  To James' miserable end,  And always keep a-hold of Nurse  For fear of finding something worse.

58016-peeps-at-many-lands-newfoundland.title: Newfoundland
58016-peeps-at-many-lands-newfoundland.creator: Ford Fairford
58016-peeps-at-many-lands-newfoundland.description: A book by Ford Fairford. It would not be an exaggeration to say that Newfoundland, although it is the most ancient of the British Colonies, is less known and understood in Great Britain than any of her oversea possessions. It is generally believed that Newfoundland is somewhere in the Arctic Circle; that the inhabitants are clothed in furs, live in snow huts, feed on codfish; and that for six months of the year the island is unapproachable on account of barriers of ice and impenetrable fogs. This is altogether untrue.

70402-dynasty-of-the-lost.title: Dynasty Of The Lost
70402-dynasty-of-the-lost.creator: Unknown
70402-dynasty-of-the-lost.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It was far too much to believe. Harry Vinson's mind rebelled; he reeled dizzily, turned in a dreamlike stupor and left the room. Moments later he was in his car and driving back to his bachelor quarters in the city, some miles away. Vinson was still in a daze as he undressed and got into bed.

arxiv-2012-09450.title: Regularity of Solutions to the Fractional Cheeger-Laplacian on Domains in Metric Spaces of Bounded Geometry
arxiv-2012-09450.creator: Sylvester Eriksson-Bique, Gianmarco Giovannardi, Riikka Korte
arxiv-2012-09450.description: Abstract We study existence, uniqueness, and regularity properties of the Dirichlet problem related to fractional Dirichlet energy minimizers in a complete doubling metric measure space ( X , d X , μ X ) (X,d_{X},\mu_{X}) satisfying a 2 2 -Poincaré inequality.

arxiv-2201-05931.title: On eliminating blocking interference of RFID unauthorized reader detection system
arxiv-2201-05931.creator: 1 st Degang Sun, 2 nd Yue Cui, 3 rd Siye Wang, 4 th Yanfang Zhang
arxiv-2201-05931.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by 1 st Degang Sun, 2 nd Yue Cui, 3 rd Siye Wang, 4 th Yanfang Zhang. RFID as an important component technology of IoT faces important security risks while being rapidly applied, among which the discovery of unauthorized readers in space is crucial. There are some researches proposed the unauthorized reader detection algorithm based on commercial off the shell(COTS) devices, but these detection algorithms are often easily affected by moving objects blocking interference in space, causing false alarms.

arxiv-2307-03141.title: Cosmological Interpretation for the Stochastic Signal in Pulsar Timing Arrays
arxiv-2307-03141.creator: Yu-Mei Wu, Zu-Cheng Chen, Qing-Guo Huang
arxiv-2307-03141.description: Abstract The pulsar timing array (PTA) collaborations have recently reported compelling evidence for the presence of a stochastic signal consistent with a gravitational-wave background. In this letter, we combine the latest data sets from NANOGrav, PPTA and EPTA collaborations to explore the cosmological interpretations for the detected signal from first-order phase transitions, domain walls and cosmic strings, separately.

arxiv-2404-06397.title: New Contributions to b → s ​ γ b\rightarrow s\gamma in Minimal G2HDM
arxiv-2404-06397.creator: Che Hao Liu, Van Que Tran, Qiaoyi Wen, Fanrong Xu, Tzu-Chiang Yuan
arxiv-2404-06397.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Che Hao Liu, Van Que Tran, Qiaoyi Wen, Fanrong Xu, Tzu-Chiang Yuan. We study the flavor-changing bottom quark radiative decay b → s ​ γ b\rightarrow s\gamma induced at one-loop level within the minimal gauged two-Higgs-doublet model (G2HDM). Among the three new contributions to this rare process in G2HDM, we find that only the charged Higgs ℋ ± \mathcal{H^{\pm}} contribution can be constrained by the current global fit data in B B -physics.

arxiv-2412-01977.title: A Table Theorem for Surfaces with Odd Euler Characteristic
arxiv-2412-01977.creator: Ali Naseri Sadr
arxiv-2412-01977.description: Abstract We use the square peg problem for smooth curves to prove a generalized table Theorem for real valued functions on Riemannian surfaces with odd Euler characteristic. We then use this result to prove the table conjecture for even functions on the two sphere.

arxiv-2505-23716.title: AnySplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unconstrained Views
arxiv-2505-23716.creator: Lihan Jiang, Yucheng Mao, Linning Xu, Tao Lu, Kerui Ren, Yichen Jin, Xudong Xu, Mulin Yu, Jiangmiao Pang, Feng Zhao, Dahua Lin, Bo Dai
arxiv-2505-23716.description: Abstract . We introduce AnySplat, a feed - forward network for novel - view synthesis from uncalibrated image collections. In contrast to traditional neural - rendering pipelines that demand known camera poses and per - scene optimization, or recent feed - forward methods that buckle under the computational weight of dense views—our model predicts everything in one shot.

arxiv-2506-08514.title: DiffGradCAM: A Universal Class Activation Map Resistant to Adversarial Training
arxiv-2506-08514.creator: Jacob PilandDepartment of Computer Science, Engineering, Christopher Sweet, Adam Czakja
arxiv-2506-08514.description: Abstract Class Activation Mapping (CAM) and its gradient-based variants (e.g., GradCAM) have become standard tools for explaining Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) predictions. However, these approaches typically focus on individual logits, while for neural networks using softmax, the class membership probability estimates depend only on the differences between logits, not on their absolute values.

pmc-10475452.title: Elevated arsenic level in fasting serum via ingestion of fish meat increased the risk of hypertension in humans and mice
pmc-10475452.creator: Takumi Kagawa, Nobutaka Ohgami, Tingchao He, Akira Tazaki, Shoko Ohnuma, Hisao Naito, Ichiro Yajima, Dijie Chen, Yuqi Deng, Takashi Tamura, Takaaki Kondo, Kenji Wakai, Masashi Kato
pmc-10475452.description: AimsThere has been a shortage of human studies to elucidate the association between serum arsenic levels and the prevalence of hypertension. This study multidirectionally investigated associations among arsenic exposure, dietary ingestion, and the risk of hypertension by combined human epidemiological and mouse experimental studies.

pmc-10693869.title: Impact of serum haemoglobin-to-creatinine ratio after transcatheter aortic valve implantation
pmc-10693869.creator: Akihiro Ikuta, Satoki Oka, Shunsuke Matsushita, Shingo Hirao, Kazushige Kadota, Tatsuhiko Komiya, Yasushi Fuku
pmc-10693869.description: ObjectiveThe association between a combined anaemia and renal failure index and 1-year prognosis of patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) is unexplored. We aimed to investigate a simple risk score in patients undergoing TAVI.MethodsA total of 469 consecutive patients undergoing TAVI between 2015 and 2021 were enrolled.

pmc-11507420.title: A Scoping Review of Acute Sedentary Behaviour Studies of People with Spinal Cord Injury
pmc-11507420.creator: Nathan T. Adams, Bobo Tong, Robert Buren, Matteo Ponzano, Jane Jun, Kathleen A. Martin Ginis
pmc-11507420.description: People with a spinal cord injury (SCI) report less physical activity than other populations and may engage in more sedentary behaviour (SB), especially sitting time. SB negatively impacts physiological and psychosocial outcomes in the general population, yet minimal research has explored the effects in people with SCI.

pmc-11571757.title: Association between chronic kidney disease and cardiovascular disease risk factors in elderly: results from the first phase of Fasa and Shahedieh cohort studies
pmc-11571757.creator: Fatemeh Zarshenas, Azizallah Dehghan, Masoud Mirzaei
pmc-11571757.description: BackgroundChronic kidney disease (CKD) is associated with increased cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk factors and morbidity in the elderly population. This study aimed to examine the association between CKD and CVD risk factors in the elderly population of Fasa and Yazd (Shahdieh), Iran, using the data from the enrolment phase of Fasa and Shahedieh cohort studies.

pmc-11652203.title: Editorial: Research advances on forest tree functional genomics and breeding
pmc-11652203.creator: Juan Du, Tianqi Ye, Yi An, Yicun Chen, Jack Wang, Jiehua Wang, Mengzhu Lu, Quanzi Li
pmc-11652203.description: ucts. Over the past few decades, conventional crossbreeding has helped generate plant varieties with improved agronomic and economic traits. However, conventional crossbreeding in forestry is time-intensive and has reached a bottleneck. Thus, improvement in growth and agronomic and economically important traits in tree species requires attention.

pmc-12620627.title: Multi-Omics Meets Premalignancy: Paving the Way for Early Prevention of Cancer
pmc-12620627.creator: Feiran Zhang, Ziyi Zhou, Peng Zhang, Shao Li
pmc-12620627.description: Comprehensive understanding of premalignant lesions (PMLs) represents a pivotal opportunity for cancer early detection and interception. Recently, advances in multi-omics technologies and artificial intelligence (AI) methods have provided unprecedented insights into PML-induced tumorigenesis. In this paper, we firstly catalog clinically recognized PMLs across 15 cancer types, emphasizing their epidemiological profiles and malignant transformation potentials.

pmc-12710942.title: Tetanus toxoid immunization coverage and its determinants among pregnant women in Somalia: A cross-sectional analysis of the 2020 Demographic and Health Survey
pmc-12710942.creator: Hamze G. Dahir, Abdisalam Hassan Muse, Abdirashid M. Yousuf, Abdisalam Mahdi Hassan
pmc-12710942.description: Maternal and neonatal tetanus (MNT) remains a significant, yet preventable, cause of death. Given that Somalia faces critically low immunization coverage, identifying the coverage and associated factors is essential for developing targeted public health strategies. This cross-sectional study analyzed data from 6411 pregnant women (aged 15–49 years) extracted from the 2020 Somalia Demographic and Health Survey (SDHS).

pmc-13003591.title: Immunohistochemical Detection of Microglia Using Iba-1 as a Marker in Health and Disease
pmc-13003591.creator: V.V. Guselnikova, O.V. Kirik, D.A. Sufieva, V.A. Razenkova, A.A. Beketova, D.E. Korzhevskii
pmc-13003591.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The aim of the study was to evaluate the possibilities and limitations of using the immunohistochemical detection of Iba-1 protein for morphofunctional analysis of microglia under different conditions.Materials and MethodsIn the study we used brain samples from Wistar rats at different ages: 7 days of postnatal development (n=18), 14 days of postnatal development (n=18), 4–6 months (n=22); the brain samples from 3–6-month-old SHR (spontaneously hypertensive rats) male rats (n=4); human cerebral cortex samples (n=10).

pmc-13069003.title: Penetrating Abdominal Trauma With Small Bowel Evisceration: A Clinical Image
pmc-13069003.creator: Chukwuka Elendu
pmc-13069003.description: Penetrating abdominal trauma with visible bowel evisceration signals severe underlying injury and mandates immediate surgical consultation. Early recognition, careful handling of exposed viscera, and avoidance of inappropriate bedside manipulation are critical to prevent ischemic injury, infection, and adverse outcomes while definitive operative care is arranged. A young adult male presented following a penetrating abdominal injury sustained during an interpersonal assault.

pmc-13335933.title: N, S Co‐Doped Carbon Quantum Dots‐Riboflavin Composite Photosensitizers for Enhanced Iontophoresis‐Assisted Corneal Cross‐Linking
pmc-13335933.creator: Tinghong Xu, Yong Liu, Wenjing Zhang, Qiuruo Jiang, Yi Jin, Liangzheng Lin, Lumeng Wang, Zhanhao Gu, Mimi Lin, Shihao Chen
pmc-13335933.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Iontophoresis‐assisted corneal cross‐linking (I‐CXL) is an emerging transepithelial technique for treating keratoconus. I‐CXL employs a small electric current to enhance the corneal penetration of riboflavin 5′‐phosphate sodium (RF), avoiding the de‐epithelialization side effects associated with conventional CXL (C‐CXL). However, I‐CXL is less effective than C‐CXL due to insufficient RF surface charge hindering iontophoresis response and absorption efficiency, as well as inadequate reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation in the corneal stroma.

pmc-13441324.title: Perineurioma‐like EMA‐positive calvarial neoplasms: clinicopathological study of eight cases
pmc-13441324.creator: Raheel Rizwan, Yingting Mok, Josephine K Dermawan, Alexandra Isaacson, Veronica Ulici, Scott E Kilpatrick, John D Reith, Gabrielle Yeaney, Hakan Ilaslan, Karen J Fritchie
pmc-13441324.description: BackgroundIncidental skull lesions are increasingly detected due to the widespread use of brain imaging. We have encountered an unusual cohort of unclassifiable calvarial spindle cell lesions showing phenotypic overlap with perineurioma and meningioma, which we sought to further characterize.Material and methodsCases of unclassifiable low‐grade spindle cell lesions arising in the calvarium were collected. Clinical, radiological and pathological findings were reviewed.

pmc-13508430.title: Traditional wisdom unveiled: an ethnobotanical exploration of medicinal bath plants for postpartum and infant healthcare among the Hakka people in Guangdong, China
pmc-13508430.creator: Donglin Li, Zhicheng Wu, Shuying Lv, Yuelan Meng, Zhendong Xie, Chongjian Ma, Xilong Zheng

pmc-13513971.title: Single-Cell and Spatial Omics Technologies in Rice Abiotic Stress Biology: A Methodological Review
pmc-13513971.creator: Junxiao Chen, Zheng Chen, Chun Yin, Lei Zhou, Da Zhao
pmc-13513971.description: Abiotic stresses—drought, salinity, extreme temperature, flooding, and heavy-metal toxicity—constrain rice (Oryza sativa L.) yield worldwide, and the cellular programmes underlying them are unevenly distributed across cell types that bulk-tissue assays average together. This review examines, from a methodological standpoint, what single-cell and spatial omics technologies can and cannot establish about rice abiotic stress biology.
